title: Fruits of the Earth
description: Discover the hidden architecture inside three remarkable fruits, each concealing intricate seed arrangements and layered flesh that reveal nature's ingenious design.

objects.label: Pomegranate
objects.placard_description: The pomegranate's leathery exterior conceals hundreds of arils — jewel-like seed casings arranged in precise geometric chambers separated by bitter white pith.

objects.label: Apple
objects.placard_description: Beneath its familiar skin, an apple's flesh is organized around a central core housing five seed chambers, each a product of millions of years of co-evolution with fruit-eating animals.

objects.label: Avocado
objects.placard_description: The avocado's large central seed — the largest of any commercially grown fruit — is surrounded by buttery flesh rich in monounsaturated fats, a botanical strategy for attracting large-bodied seed dispersers.
